compress_function: compress 8-bit 16kHz mono audio bytes to FLAC format using the FLAC codec
decompress_function: decompress FLAC-encoded bytes back to 8-bit 16kHz mono audio data losslessly
compress_decompress_roundtrip: compress audio bytes with FLAC then decompress to verify lossless roundtrip
compress_8bit_audio: compress raw 8-bit 16kHz mono audio data into compressed FLAC bytes
decompress_flac_bytes: decompress FLAC bytes from 16-bit back to original 8-bit audio data
